content.title: The Other Path
content.narrative:
YY came to the dogwood fork with his cheek empty and his opinions ready.

At the fork below the dogwood, two clear paths show fresh prints, and a small pile of seed shells has collected beside the left turn. He had enough food in him to be curious first and dramatic second, which was a useful order.

"Well," YY said. "That is not snack-shaped. Rude, but interesting."

YY counted seed shells at the fork, chose the quieter right path, and found enough early clover to keep moving. No one had asked him to name it. That helped. YY liked a thing better when it did not arrive wearing a job.

By sundown his food had moved from 0.60 to 0.62, health from 0.83 to 0.84, and attention from 0.68 to 0.70. YY did not say the numbers out loud. He did say, very softly, "Noted."

He came home with the the other path behind him, a little more food than he woke with, and one clear place in the wood changed enough to remember.

content.summary: YY met the other path on 2026-05-12, answered it with a practical body-first choice, and came home with the wood slightly better mapped.
